description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the PasswordStrengthService component of the OrangeHRM authentication system. It contains unit tests that verify the correctness of password policy checks, URL validation, password enforcement, and related functionalities within the PasswordStrengthService class.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the PasswordStrengthService functionalities such as password policy checks, URL validation, and enforcement logging within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by instantiating PasswordStrengthService, loading test data, and mocking necessary services.

methods.name: testGetEnforcePasswordDao
methods.description: Tests that getEnforcePasswordDao returns an instance of EnforcePasswordDao.

methods.name: testCheckPasswordPolicies
methods.description: Verifies that password policy checks produce the expected messages based on the password complexity.

methods.name: testIsValidPassword
methods.description: Checks whether passwords are validated correctly against minimum strength requirements.

methods.name: testLogPasswordEnforceRequest
methods.description: Tests logging of enforce password requests, ensuring a string result is returned.

methods.name: testValidateUrl
methods.description: Verifies that a given URL is validated correctly based on the current date/time context.

methods.name: testGetUserNameByResetCode
methods.description: Confirms that reset codes correctly map to associated usernames.

methods.name: testSaveEnforcedPassword
methods.description: Tests the saving of enforced passwords for users, verifying success and failure scenarios.
